title: Disposable Slimeball
description: Simple disposable slimeball, you can throw it and boom magic
body: Disposable Slimeball is a lightweight and straightforward Minecraft mod that adds a simple but fun mechanic: slimeballs can now be thrown like projectiles. This small feature opens up new creative and playful possibilities, whether you want an easy ranged item early in the game or just enjoy messing around with bouncing shots. The mod stays true to vanilla style, keeping everything balanced and intuitive while offering a fresh way to use an otherwise common item.
